import random,itertools
from fractions import Fraction
random.seed(44)
for trial in range(50000):
 S=random.randint(1,3);J=random.randint(1,6);F=random.randint(1,3);G=random.randint(0,2)
 B=random.randint(1,4);I=random.randint(0,B);slots=[];t=random.randint(0,2)
 for s in range(S):
  if s>0:t+=random.randint(1,3)
  slots.append([t,random.randint(0,3),0 if s==0 else random.randint(0,3)])
 flows=[]
 for f in range(F):
  target=random.randint(1,3);ceiling=random.randint(target,4)
  flows.append([target,ceiling,(-1 if G==0 or random.random()<.35 else random.randrange(G)),random.randrange(7)])
 groups=[]
 for g in range(G):groups.append([-1 if g==0 or random.random()<.5 else random.randrange(g),random.randint(0,5)])
 wins=[]
 for j in range(J):
  f=random.randrange(F);ready=random.randint(0,max(0,t+1));exp=random.randint(ready,max(ready,t+1))
  wins.append([f,ready,exp,random.randint(1,65535),random.randint(1,320),random.randint(0,65535),random.randint(1,10),[[0,0]]*9])
 th=[random.choice([0,1,32767,65535]) for _ in wins]
 # ancestor
 anc=[]
 for f,(tt,c,g,l) in enumerate(flows):
  if g==-1:anc.append([])
  else:
   a=[];x=g
   while x!=-1:a.append(x);x=groups[x][0]
   anc.append(a)
 opts=[]
 for j,w in enumerate(wins):opts.append([-1] if w[5]>=th[j] else [-1]+[s for s,(tm,cp,rf) in enumerate(slots) if w[1]<=tm<=w[2]])
 bestcov=None;bestkey=None;bestcount=None;maxcount_at_best=None
 allopt=[]
 for ass in itertools.product(*opts):
  cnt=[0]*S
  for s in ass:
   if s>=0:cnt[s]+=1
  avail=I;ok=True
  for s,(tm,cp,rf) in enumerate(slots):
   if s>0:avail=min(B,avail+rf)
   if cnt[s]>cp or cnt[s]>avail:ok=False;break
   avail-=cnt[s]
  if not ok:continue
  nf=[0]*F
  for j,s in enumerate(ass):
   if s>=0:nf[wins[j][0]]+=1
  if any(nf[f]>flows[f][1] for f in range(F)):continue
  gc=[0]*G
  for f in range(F):
   for g in anc[f]:gc[g]+=nf[f]
  if any(gc[g]>groups[g][1] for g in range(G)):continue
  cov=min(min(Fraction(1),Fraction(nf[f],flows[f][0])) for f in range(F))
  U=sum(wins[j][6] for j,s in enumerate(ass) if s>=0)
  A=sum(slots[s][0]-wins[j][1] for j,s in enumerate(ass) if s>=0)
  key=(U,-A)
  count=sum(s>=0 for s in ass)
  if bestcov is None or cov>bestcov:
   bestcov=cov;bestkey=key;bestcount=count;maxcount_at_best=count
  elif cov==bestcov:
   if count>maxcount_at_best:maxcount_at_best=count
   if key>bestkey:bestkey=key;bestcount=count
 if bestcount<maxcount_at_best:
  print('FOUND trial',trial,'bestcov',bestcov,'bestcount',bestcount,'maxcount',maxcount_at_best,'key',bestkey)
  print('SJFG',S,J,F,G,'bucket',B,I,'slots',slots,'flows',flows,'groups',groups,'wins',wins,'th',th)
  break
else:print('none found')
